text.ruty.offer: Hey, brother! I hear you've been fishing. Mind if I ask you something?{page}I study fish, see. I've seen every sea fish that comes through this port... but never one from inland.{page}River fish, pond fish... I've only ever read about 'em. You'd tell me what you catch, wouldn't ya?{page}Catch every kind in %1 and %2, and I'll get you a real rod off the next boat in. Deal?
text.ruty.inland_waiting: %1 more kinds to go, brother?{page}I've got a page in my notebook for each one. Don't leave me hanging!{page}If one won't bite, try another bait. Fish are picky. Like my customers.
text.ruty.sea_rod: Every kind in %1 and %2? You're amazing, brother! My notebook's never been so full.{page}Here. A sailor owed me a favor, and this is how he paid me back. It's yours now.
text.ruty.mardan_ask: There's one page I still can't fill. The Mardan Garayan.{page}Folks say seeing one brings you happiness. I've wanted to see one since I was a little girl.{page}If you ever catch one, tell me first, okay? Not Suzy. Me.
text.ruty.mardan_waiting: Any luck with the Mardan Garayan?{page}I hear it won't touch worms. Only fruit. Strange tastes for a fish.{page}Then again, Mr. King won't eat fish at all. Who am I to judge?
text.ruty.garayan_rod: You... you really caught one!? Tell me everything! What color was it? How big was it?{page}...I feel happy just hearing about it. Guess the stories were true.{page}You've earned better than that rod. I was saving this one for something special. This is it.
text.ruty.baron_tale: Hey, between you and me...{page}There's a drawing in my oldest fish book. A Garayan bigger than any net. The book calls it the Baron.{page}Nobody's seen one in a hundred years. Most folks say it never existed.{page}But a week ago, I'd have said the same about the Mardan Garayan.
text.ruty.baron_waiting: Still chasing the Baron?{page}If it's half as big as that drawing, hold on tight. I don't wanna be the one fishing YOU out of the water.
text.ruty.baron_rod: No way... The Baron Garayan!?{page}A hundred years, and you're the one who found it! My old book was right!{page}Here, brother. It's the best rod I've got. I was gonna sell it, but... nobody deserves it more than you.
text.ruty.suzy: Just don't tell Suzy I gave it away for free. She'd never let me hear the end of it.
text.ruty.afterwards: My notebook's full, thanks to you.{page}Come buy some fish sometime, brother. I'll give ya the friend's price.
text.ruty.no_room: Your bag's full, brother. Make some room, and I'll give you what I owe ya.
